name: Amazigh Spearmen

abilities.name: Square
abilities.text: The unit moves into a close square formation. Note that it cannot move whilst this ability is active.

abilities.name: Steady
abilities.text: Improves the unit's ability to defend at the cost of their mobility.

attributes.name: Expert Charge Defence
attributes.text: This unit’s melee attack and damage are increased against charging enemies.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

short: A spear to fight for their people, and their future.
history: The Amazigh, a Berber people, first appear in sources during the rise of the Roman Republic, populating the province of Cyrenaica, with some eventually adopting and propagating Christianity. The Amazigh spent most of antiquity under Roman rule in Cyrenaica, yet fought in a series of struggles, both open and underground, against their overlords for hundreds of years. As the Western Roman Empire collapsed, the Amazigh were thrown into disorder, but an opportunistic one. The shattering of Imperial authority marked the return of the Berbers from the fringes of the Empire, allowing them to resettle as they pleased: there is evidence of Berber kingdoms rising all across the defunct African province.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
